narrative_summary: The developer specializes in Victron Venus OS energy systems, building D-Bus and MQTT bridges for JBD/Daly BMS batteries, Tasmota PV meters, and grid-zero inverter control. ESPHome BLE sensor patterns for ESP32 proxies integrate battery monitors and environmental sensors into Home Assistant, demonstrating end-to-end energy and battery management. Additional work includes MQTT observability with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana, RAG pipelines for Victron documentation, and voice assistant gateways for Alexa and Google Home. Infrastructure experience spans K3s and Docker Compose edge deployments, with a focus on production-ready IoT patterns rather than low-level embedded firmware.
key_strengths: Venus OS D-Bus/MQTT integration for batteries and inverters
ESPHome BLE proxy patterns for JBD and Daly BMS
IoT observability with OpenTelemetry and Prometheus/Grafana
Energy forecasting and Victron documentation RAG pipeline
Multi-protocol bridging across MQTT, D-Bus, WebSocket, and BLE
growth_areas: Low-level embedded firmware in C/C++ or RTOS environments
Industrial IoT protocols such as Modbus TCP/RTU and CANbus
BMS hardware design and cell balancing implementation
